title: OpenAI banned Israel-linked operation using AI for influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to an Israel-origin operation, dubbed 'Zero Zeno', using AI to generate anti-Hamas, anti-Qatar, pro-Israel, anti-BJP, and pro-Histadrut content.
why_included: This highlights AI's use in shaping narratives and influencing opinions on geopolitical conflicts and OpenAI's detection of these operations.

title: OpenAI banned China-linked operation using AI for influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the PRC-origin operation 'Spamouflage', using AI to research social media activity, generate posts, and debug a website.
why_included: This exposes AI's role in coordinated influence campaigns originating from China and OpenAI's measures to counter them.

title: OpenAI banned Russian-linked accounts using AI for Telegram comments
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a Russia-origin operation, dubbed 'Bad Grammar', using AI to generate Telegram comments on Ukraine, Moldova, Baltic, and US politics.
why_included: This demonstrates AI's use in political commentary and influence operations targeting specific regions, with OpenAI taking action against such activities.

title: OpenAI banned Iran-linked influence content network using AI
summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the Iran-origin operation 'IUVM', using AI to generate and translate pro-Iran, anti-Israel, and anti-US website content.
why_included: This details AI's use in generating and disseminating propaganda by Iranian actors, and OpenAI's actions to counter these influence operations.
